title: Transport of the strict scalar tensor comparison to total limits
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W and coefficient system calculi SE,SL, normalized Roos models rhoE,rhoL, a normalized scalar model SY, and tensor models TE,TL as in the tensor limit-square statement. Let α be any derived natural isomorphism satisfying DerivedSigmaModel for SE and SL. For integral constructible M,N and a completeness proof for their completed E tensor, the composite of scalarTensorCompleted, TL.realization and the total limit of the SL tensor of the two scalarReduction maps equals SY.realization followed by the total limit of sequence scalar applied to tensorReduction_E and then α. This is the localization and total-limit transport step; finite strict tensor balancing is contained in the hypothesis DerivedSigmaModel.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; localization and derived-limit part of realization step 8 of lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence.

proof.text: Choose simultaneous flat-term K-flat representatives of M and N. Apply the normalization equations of SY and TL to their quotient presentations and use DerivedSigmaModel to identify the strict scalar/tensor map. Naturality of the Roos bridge and completion isomorphisms transports the equality from representatives to completed objects; localization removes representative choices and total-limit functoriality gives the displayed equation. Zero complexes, identity coefficients and ramified quotient transitions satisfy the same transport.

proof_origin.place: Localization and derived-limit transport after the strict normalized scalar tensor equation.

theorem scalarTowerTensorLimitSquare_of_derivedSigmaModel (W : Scheme.{u})
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l L W)
    (ρE : IntegralComparisonRoosModel.{u, u} l E W)
    (ρL : IntegralComparisonRoosModel.{u, u} l L W)
    (SY : IntegralComparisonScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι W SE ρL)
    (TE : TensorModel l E W SE ρE) (TL : TensorModel l L W SL ρL)
    (_hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E W)
    (hT : IsSfDerivedComplete l E W
      ((integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E W).obj (M.obj, N.obj)))
    (α : SE.systemClosed.tensor ⋙ integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W ≅
      (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W).prod
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W) ⋙ SL.systemClosed.tensor)
    (hα : DerivedSigmaModel l E L ι W SE SL α) :
    (scalarTensorCompleted l E L ι W M.obj N.obj M.property.1 N.property.1 hT).hom ≫
        TL.realization.hom.app
          ((integralScalarExtension.{u} l E L ι W).obj M.obj,
            (integralScalarExtension.{u} l E L ι W).obj N.obj) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L W).map
          (SL.systemClosed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
            (scalarReduction l E L ι W SE SL ρL SY M.obj)
            (scalarReduction l E L ι W SE SL ρL SY N.obj))) =
      SY.realization.hom.app
          ((integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E W).obj (M.obj, N.obj)) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L W).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W).map
            (tensorReduction l E W SE ρE TE M.obj N.obj) ≫
          α.hom.app (SE.reduction.obj M.obj, SE.reduction.obj N.obj))
